dedupe_keys.name: accreu integrated flood exposure land use impact crop and grassland loss workflows 2020 2050 scenarios iiasa

description: A set of R workflows and their outputs that link river flooding to farm land and crop outcomes under climate and land-use scenarios. The README says they quantify flooded area per land-use class for several models, RCPs and adaptation or mitigation strategies in snapshot years 2020 to 2050, convert flooded area into production and revenue losses for crops and grassland, link flooding to grass-feed gaps, and turn land-use scenario outputs into crop area, production and revenue per polygon. Outputs include per-polygon CSV tables, GeoTIFF stacks of flooded land-use fractions and PDF plots. The release of 8 July 2025 is a free downloadable ZIP of about 487 MB under the MIT licence, made in the ACCREU project by authors at IIASA and Mendel University in Brno. Coverage is the simulation units of the land-use models used; the models and region are not named in the pages read. Caveats: the input land-use scenarios come from external models and paths must be set in each script. For simulation it gives a ready chain from flood hazard to farm production and revenue loss under future scenarios. Related catalogue records include GLOBIOM and CLIMADA.
